about: The Softanza estate as Radar reads it: the layers of the stack, the projects in each, the domains a piece of news can touch, and the concerns at stake. An entry names its projects in `areas`, and its `domains` and `concerns` from the lists below; the feed tool refuses a name that is not here.

layers.name: Interfaces and applications
layers.line: what people see, use and learn with

layers.name: Intelligence
layers.line: models and agents on your own device, under a governed actor

layers.name: Web and server
layers.line: Haro in the browser and on the server

layers.name: Data
layers.line: one governed store for every face

layers.name: Foundation
layers.line: the library and its engine, under everything else

layers.name: Language
layers.line: the language you declare your domain in

layers.name: Machine
layers.line: the computer itself, declared in one file

layers.name: Harness
layers.line: how Softanza is built and kept watch over

projects.name: Zane
projects.line: The interface language and its constitution: rules a machine checks, so every screen reads well.

projects.name: Atelier
projects.line: The library's own examples, run live as checks, with a playground to try them.

projects.name: Zindara
projects.line: Softanza's education offering: courses, missions, projects and a tutor, for schools and learning designers.

projects.name: Aïcha
projects.line: Knowledge, models and agents on your own device: a model proposes, a governed actor commits.

projects.name: HaroServ
projects.line: The server for Haro applications and web services.

projects.name: HaroBase
projects.line: The governed store every Softanza face shares: SQLite in the process, governed.

projects.name: Softanza
projects.line: The foundation: the library and its Zig engine, with every medium plane.

projects.name: Haro
projects.line: The language of languages: declare the language of your domain, and Haro runs it, on its own virtual machine and compiler.

projects.name: Harobanda
projects.line: The declared machine: describe the whole computer in one text file; it boots exactly that and checks every boot against it.

projects.name: Takamba
projects.line: The harness: many working sessions on one body of work, under laws each cited to the incident that taught it.

projects.name: Softanza Radar
projects.line: This watch: what moves in AI and the tech field, read from Softanza's point of view, in a signed feed.
